trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Oil Surge
trends.summary: Active military conflict in Middle East with Iranian attacks on US bases in Gulf states and Trump's stated objective to control Iranian oil resources. Brent crude heading for record monthly gains with geopolitical uncertainty driving energy markets higher and creating broader market volatility.

trends.name: Asian Markets & Yen Pressure From Energy Crisis
trends.summary: Japan's stock market down nearly 5% as Middle East conflict intensifies energy costs and inflation concerns. Japan stepping up yen warnings amid stagflationary pressures from energy crisis, while South Korea's Kospi leading regional declines in week five of conflict.

trends.name: Chip Sector Prioritization: AI Over Smartphones
trends.summary: SUMCO delays Saga wafer plant indefinitely, signaling industry shift of manufacturing capacity toward AI chips over smartphone production. Reflects structural demand reallocation across semiconductor supply chains driven by AI investment boom.

trends.name: AI Drug Development & Pharma Deals
trends.summary: Eli Lilly's $2.75 billion partnership with Insilico to commercialize AI-developed drugs represents major validation of AI in pharmaceutical R&D. Signals accelerating shift toward computational drug discovery and globalization of biotech innovation.

trends.name: S&P 500 Valuation Reset & Earnings Yield Recovery
trends.summary: S&P 500 earnings yield jumps back over 5% amid market selloffs, improving valuation metrics after period of compression. Potential buy signal for value-oriented investors despite near-term geopolitical uncertainty weighing on sentiment.

trends.name: Trump's Stock Market Influence Waning
trends.summary: Sustained equity declines despite Trump administration policies suggest the president's traditional market-supportive influence has eroded. Reflects investor skepticism over Iran conflict endgame and uncertain policy outcomes.

trends.name: Dollar Strength From Energy Tailwinds
trends.summary: US dollar supported by rising oil prices and energy market volatility tied to Middle East conflict. Energy tailwinds may be temporary, with potential dollar weakness ahead if geopolitical tensions ease.

trends.name: Meta's AI Research & Legal Headwinds
trends.summary: Meta facing court losses that could constrain AI research capabilities and consumer data practices. Legal setbacks create operational and reputational risks for company's competitive position in AI arms race.

trends.name: Nvidia's Structural Strength vs Amazon
trends.summary: Panel regression analysis reveals Nvidia's superior structural fundamentals compared to Amazon, with stronger competitive moat in AI infrastructure. Validates premium valuation despite recent sector volatility.

trends.name: Real Estate: Trump Homebuying Ban vs Deal Economics
trends.summary: Trump administration ban on investor homebuying creates unintended consequences for broader real estate deal-making. Policy impacts residential investment landscape and potential developer financing challenges.

trends.name: Defense Sector Valuation Exhaustion
trends.summary: NATO defense spending boom already priced into equities with limited upside remaining despite geopolitical tailwinds. Defense stocks face valuation headwinds despite structural support from conflict escalation.

trends.name: Consumer Stock Bargains: Nike, Urban Outfitters, Conagra
trends.summary: Nike trading at 9-year lows heading into earnings amid turnaround doubts; Urban Outfitters and Conagra presenting deep value opportunities with strong dividend yields. Market dislocations creating tactical entry points for contrarian investors.
